verdict.rationale: Warp ships two official CLIs. The Oz CLI is documented as running and managing cloud agents from any terminal, script, or CI pipeline, covering local and remote runs, MCP connections, integrations, and API-key auth for headless use. The standalone Warp Agent CLI (the `warp` command) works in any terminal or over SSH and controls interactive apps through its own PTY. The probe confirms a dedicated CLI reference page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of either CLI working as documented.
